# SPD-058 — Delete a ticket's worktree and local branch once its code has landed

## Brief
Eric, 2026-09-14: worktrees get deleted once the code is merged and the worktree is no longer needed. Today the protocol ends every code ticket with ExitWorktree (keep) and never removes anything, so .claude/worktrees holds 13 merged, clean worktrees. Add the removal step to CLAUDE.md (Return step, Main and worktrees, the other-project recipe) and clear the worktrees already landed.

## Size, persona and model decision
Spud only: CLAUDE.md is Spud's own file, changed at Eric's ask; the cleanup is git on merged, clean worktrees. No spudagent.

## Team

## Handoffs

## Proposals received

## Outcome
CLAUDE.md now deletes a ticket's worktree and local branch right after its code lands: the Return step, a Main and worktrees bullet (git worktree remove, then git branch -d, never --force; ExitWorktree stays keep; unmerged worktrees stay until Eric drops them), the other-project recipe, and the pr landing (squash-merged, so branch -D once the PR is MERGED). The 12 merged, clean worktrees at the home were removed; remote branches stay on origin.
